entities.name: Abu Sa‘id al-Khudri
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū Saʿīd Saʿd ibn Mālik ibn Sinān al-Khazrajī al-Khudrī was an early ally (Ansari) of the Islamic prophet Muhammad and one of the younger companions of the prophet, as well as being a supporter of Hadith prohibition.
